name: Maker credentials vs end-user credentials
symptom: Dispatch succeeds for any chat user with no prompt and the API logs createdBy anonymous; a connector tool set to end-user credentials asks each user for their own connection, which for an API key means the key
cause: An agent flow runs with the connections its author selected; an API key is a shared secret, not a user identity
fix: Keep API key tools on maker credentials and control who can chat; use OAuth (AUTH_MODE=entra) with end-user credentials when the API must know the user

name: Agent flow 100-second response limit
symptom: With delayMs=120000 the agent reports the tool failed or could not complete while the flow run continues (observe and record exact text)
cause: An agent flow must respond to the agent within 100 seconds
fix: Remove the delay; respond early and continue (asynchronous response, CS-A04); express mode (CS-A03, PREVIEW) only helps when the flow itself is slow

name: Flows created outside a solution have no connection references
symptom: Flow added to HLEHarbourlineOps still uses a connection; flow checker warns Use connection references; after export and import the flow cannot be turned on without manual fixes
cause: Flows created outside a solution use connections directly and are not upgraded when added to a solution
fix: Create flows inside the solution, or use the flow checker action to remove connections and add connection references; import custom connectors in a separate solution first

name: Data policy (DLP) blocks the custom connector
symptom: Flows marked Suspended; flow checker shows a data policy error; agent tool call fails (observe and record)
cause: HLE Outage API is Blocked, or is in a different data group from Dataverse in the same flow
fix: Move HLE Outage API to the same group as Dataverse (Business) or remove the policy, then turn the flows back on
